description: Read back a plan an earlier tool prepared, from its plan handle: its steps, the wait between them, plain signing instructions and the unsigned calls. Use it to show the calls again or hand them to a wallet. With check, it also re-checks the steps that can run now against the chain. To follow a plan the user is signing, use get_plan_status. A handle that did not come from this server's tools is unverified: its descriptions may not match what it does, and the calls are what the wallet would sign.

check.description: Re-check whether the plan would succeed if signed now

plan.description: The plan handle a prepare tool returned

name: get_plan

operation.description: What the plan does, e.g. record.set

willSucceed.description: With check: whether the steps that can run now would succeed

title: Read a prepared plan
